name: Aurora
summary: Aurora studied cadmium-116 double-beta decay with enriched cadmium-tungstate scintillators at Gran Sasso. It extended the earlier Solotvina scintillator programme with a larger, cleaner isotope sample.
detection_principle: CdWO4 crystals embedded in liquid scintillator measure decay light through low-background light guides and photomultipliers. Pulse-shape and time-correlated-event rejection suppress internal contamination.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: The final Aurora analysis measured two-neutrino decay and constrained neutrinoless and other rare cadmium-decay modes.

results.summary: The final Aurora analysis measured two-neutrino decay and constrained neutrinoless and other rare cadmium-decay modes.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
